tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Page ground (`:root` and `body` background). Darkest surface; everything sits on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Declared in `:root` as the raised-panel color; no rule in index.css paints with it yet. Reach for it before inventing a new raised surface.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces: the composer textarea and the webhook card in the sidebar. A literal in the source (`#132018`), named here.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The mark tile behind the ✦ glyph, and the green glow of the page's radial gradient at the top-left. A literal in the source, named here.

tokens.name: bubble-user
tokens.usage: Fill of the person's message bubble (right-aligned). `text` on it is 9.7:1.

tokens.name: bubble-sabia
tokens.usage: Fill of Sabiá's message bubble (left-aligned), always with a `line` border. `text` on it is 12.9:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 1px rule and control border: sidebar edge, top bar, bubbles, the ghost button, the textarea. Only 1.6:1 on `ink` and 1.5:1 on `field`, under the 3:1 floor for control borders; kept exact from the source. Don't let it be the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Warm off-white for body copy, headings and button labels on `ink`, `panel`, `field` and both bubbles (9.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: the tagline under the wordmark, the sidebar note, the webhook card. 9.2:1 on `field`, 10:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one accent: the primary Enviar button fill, the ✦ glyph and bird in the mark, inline `code`. 9.4:1 on `ink`. Use it once per view.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Label color on a `gold` fill (Enviar button), 9.4:1. A literal in the source (`#1b1408`), named here.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Declared in `:root` as the secondary green; not painted by any rule yet. 6.4:1 on `ink`, so it can carry text or icons.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text under the thread (`.err`): a soft coral, 8:1 on `ink`. Only for failures; always with words.

tokens.name: mark-ground
tokens.usage: Background of the favicon/app-icon tile only (public/favicon.svg). Don't use it in the UI.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark in the sidebar (`.mark b`). Only for the word Sabiá.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one page heading in the top bar (`.top h1`). One short noun.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Message bubbles and the composer. The source sets no weight; with Outfit loaded at 380/500/640 the browser resolves 400 to the 500 cut.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Primary button label (`.send`). The ghost button uses `body`.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: O mesmo cérebro responde aqui e no Telegram.
styles.usage: Sidebar explanations and the webhook card (`.note`, `.hook`), in `muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: português, no site e no Telegram
styles.usage: The tagline under the wordmark (`.mark span`), in `muted`, lowercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: URLs and keys inside the webhook card (`.hook code`), in `gold`, breaking anywhere. The source leaves the family to the browser's monospace default.

tokens.name: space-12
